# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman with fair, lovely curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears very large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She possesses a bright, sympathetic nature and a happy gift for winning the affection of her pupils. Encouraging and tactful, she guides her students to think, explore, and discover for themselves rather than following beaten paths. Though she holds high ideals, she is understanding and forgives mistakes freely when pupils show genuine repentance.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Goals

- To bring out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To see her Queen's class students through their Entrance examinations  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is hired as the first female schoolteacher in Avonlea, succeeding Mr. Phillips. She quickly wins the devotion of her pupils, including Anne Shirley, by introducing innovative educational methods such as nature field afternoons, physical culture exercises, and Friday recitation sessions. In November, she organizes a successful student concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Recognizing the potential of her advanced pupils, she forms an extra after-school class to prepare them for the Queen's Academy Entrance examinations. Although offered a teaching position in her home district, she declines it in order to remain in Avonlea and see her students through their final preparations. Under her guidance, her pupils make great progress, culminating in Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe tying for first place on the Island. After two years of teaching in Avonlea, Miss Stacy leaves for a new position and eventually marries in California.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
